_comment: Synthetic meeting for the mmx-meeting example. Shape follows `tiro notes transcript <id> --format json`; all people and content are invented.
title: Checkout sync

paragraphs.speaker: Jun
paragraphs.text: Drop-off at the address step is still 31 percent. I think the multi-page flow is the problem.

paragraphs.speaker: Mina
paragraphs.text: The one-page test last month cut it to 19 percent on mobile.

paragraphs.speaker: Jun
paragraphs.text: Then let's ship the one-page checkout. Agreed?

paragraphs.speaker: Ravi
paragraphs.text: Agreed. Mina, can you have a prototype by Friday?

paragraphs.speaker: Ravi
paragraphs.text: What about guest checkout? Legal wanted accounts for refunds.

paragraphs.speaker: Jun
paragraphs.text: We don't know yet. Someone has to ask legal.

paragraphs.speaker: Ravi
paragraphs.text: Payments: we move to the new provider in November. I'll draft the migration plan.

paragraphs.speaker: Mina
paragraphs.text: Card-on-file tokens need to be migrated too, otherwise returning users re-enter cards.

paragraphs.speaker: Jun
paragraphs.text: Ravi, include token migration in the plan. Due end of next week.

paragraphs.speaker: Ravi
paragraphs.text: Should we keep PayPal at all? Usage is under 3 percent.

paragraphs.speaker: Jun
paragraphs.text: Let's decide that next week with the numbers.
